summary: First full pass. Backend: 25/26 pytest pass; 1 HIGH profitability bug: after unmarking a material purchase the obra cost still counts it (auth+role guards, solicitudes idempotency/mine/lookup, presupuesto→aceptar→convertir-obra→material purchase→mano obra→cobro with numero_factura and beneficio recalculation, PERSONAL_HOGAR+obra_id 422, EMPRESA vs HOGAR resumen, gestoría + CSV token/401, ferreterías derivación cobrada→Comisiones INGRESO, publicidad, store /me + anuncios incl. fecha_fin '' clearing, worker obras/avance/fotos/403, configuración + probar-email 422). Frontend (375x667 web preview): all requested flows PASS — client tabs, 4-step request form → confirmation → Mis solicitudes, drawer role switch with wrong/right PIN and back to Cliente, Trabajador panel (progress 75%, phases, Cómo llegar), Ferretería panel (create/toggle/edit/delete promo, edit store info), Admin Ferreterías (KPIs, Derivar sheet, cobrada toggle, new-store sheet), Configuración (Resend Activo, CIF save persisted after reload, simulation switch), and all other admin screens load with no console errors. Only minor UI truncation issues and some code-review notes. No deprecated Expo packages found (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch); no SafeAreaView imported from react-native.

critical.issue: Unmarking a purchased material (purchase-unmark-button) deletes the EMPRESA GASTO transaction, but Obra.recalcular (core.py:239-241) still adds cantidad*precio_real for materials with comprado=false. coste_materiales_real/beneficio_neto then stay wrong (24 instead of 0 in the test) and no longer match Finanzas. Fix: only sum materials where m.comprado and precio_real is not None, or clear precio_real when unmarking (MaterialPatch exclude_none means the API cannot clear it).

minor.issue: The lockout key uses the FIRST entry of X-Forwarded-For, and the client can set that value itself. Rotating the header could get around the 5-attempt lockout, so a 4-digit PIN could be brute-forced. Use the right-most trusted proxy entry or the ingress-provided real IP instead. This is from code review only; I did not brute-force it, as instructed.

These delete INGRESO transactions that already used a numero_factura (F-YYYY-NNNN). That leaves gaps in the invoice numbering, which Spanish invoicing rules require to be consecutive. Consider cancelling them with a corrective entry instead of hard-deleting, or blocking the delete once a number is assigned.
Anonymous upload accepts any bytes declared as image/png; a non-image body returned 200. Validate magic bytes (e.g. with Pillow) and consider rate-limiting the anonymous endpoint.
The admin JWT is sent in the query string, so it can end up in proxy/access logs and browser history. Use a short-lived, single-use download token instead.
There is no DELETE or archive endpoint, so test or incorrect records cannot be removed from the admin UI (see seed_data_creation).

ui_bugs.issue: On web the 3-column KPI values are cut off ('2.20…', '1.03…' on Finanzas Personal/Hogar) because adjustsFontSizeToFit does nothing on react-native-web. Use a smaller font for long values or a 2-column layout.

Some labels are cut off at 375px: 'Llamar cli…' (worker-job-call-client-button), 'Derivar cli…' and a clipped conditions button (admin-store-referral-*, partly covered by the 'Nueva' FAB), 'Enviar por …' (quote-send-email-button). Shorten the labels or stack the buttons.

issues: The 'Nueva' FAB covers the second action button of the first store card; add bottom padding or move the FAB.

action_items: HIGH: core.py Obra.recalcular must only count materials with comprado=True; after the fix, re-run tests/test_gmconecta_api.py::TestPresupuestoObra (it asserts coste_materiales_real==0 after unmarking).
Fix the X-Forwarded-For based login lockout so it cannot be bypassed (server.py:344).
Stop hard-deleting INGRESO transactions that already have a numero_factura (admin_routes.py:942-944, movimientos DELETE); keep invoice numbering consecutive.
Validate the content of uploaded images (magic bytes) on POST /api/upload.
Fix cut-off button labels and KPI values on the 375px web preview; move or pad the FAB on /admin/ferreterias.
Optional: add archive/delete for solicitudes, presupuestos, obras and derivaciones.
Code size: admin_routes.py has 1062 lines (>700); split it into modules (presupuestos/obras/finanzas/ferreterias/config).
critical_code_review_comments: core.py:239 Obra.recalcular ignores m.comprado, so the obra's profitability and the finance ledger disagree after a purchase is unmarked.
admin_routes.py is 1062 lines; split it by domain.
Login IP is taken from a header the client controls (x-forwarded-for[0]).
Hard deletes of invoiced transactions break invoice numbering.
Anonymous upload does not check the real file type.
